title: Helios Order Visibility
summary: Supplier confirmations and customer order tracking for ERPNext
long_description: Send suppliers a private, expiring link to confirm a Purchase Order. Their answer and delivery date are written back to the Purchase Order and its lines, so the schedule in ERPNext matches what the supplier promised. Suppliers can also confirm by replying to the PO email. Customers get a read-only status page for their Sales Order or Delivery Note. Buyers get a Supplier OTD report and a late-lines page. Pages show your company's name and use your site's time zone and date format; no external service is involved.
publishing_status: submitted to Frappe Cloud Marketplace review (see SUBMISSIONS.md in the outreach repo)
